criteria.question: is DVMn 1a-c's proprioceptive drive carried by one named wing campaniform type (SNpp16)?

protocol.drive: every cell of the driven set recruited, one spike per wingbeat cycle at a uniform random phase with gaussian jitter (an 8 mV kick into each afferent), after 200 ms of settling; only phase and jitter vary with the seed

arms.S2: every other wing and haltere campaniform afferent (ADMN, DMetaN), SNpp16 withheld
arms.S3: all wing and haltere campaniform afferents
arms.null: SNpp16 alone on rewire_null(edges, seed=0) (reported, not scored)

protocol.scoring: per draw (stats.per_draw, need 0.8): each phase seed is one draw, its DVMn 1a-c rate rounded to 0.01 Hz; PASS if ceil(0.8 n) of the n seeds are in band, FAIL if at most floor(0.2 n), else UNRESOLVED

N1_snpp16_sufficient_dvmn_in_band.rule: S1 (SNpp16 alone) puts DVMn 1a-c in 2-12 Hz, scored per phase seed

N2_snpp16_necessary_dvmn_below_2hz.rule: S2 (all but SNpp16) gives DVMn 1a-c below 2 Hz, scored per phase seed (the point check is strict, per_draw's upper edge is inclusive)

electrical: shakB gap junction, 1:1 relay; Tanouye & Wyman 1980; Allen et al. 2006
shakB gap junction, 1:1 relay; Allen et al. 2006; Phelan et al. 2008
JON->GF mixed synapse modelled as electrical; shakB-dependent (Pezier et al. 2016); mixed (Pezier et al. 2014); 3 mV target untraced; contact set from MaleCNS v1.0
JON->GF mixed synapse modelled as electrical; shakB-dependent (Pezier et al. 2016); mixed (Pezier et al. 2014); 3 mV target untraced; contact set from MaleCNS v1.0
intrinsic: all-or-none GF response; von Reyn 2014; Ache 2019. Fitted by pre-stated rule (smallest value giving 1-2 spikes/response, <=2 on the strongest gain quartile, P(response) 0.5-1, TTMn relay intact; benchmarks/fit_gf_adapt.py at >=40 trials). 45 mV at w_scale 0.4 with the per-GF JON calibration (refit 2026-10-11, cloud run 13, 40 trials; the strong-quartile constraint holds at exactly 2.0, its limit; 30 mV gives 2.75). Before: 10 mV at w_scale 0.3 (2026-10-10), 30 mV under the all-trials loom input, 15 mV from an undersampled 20-trial fit. 0 mV gives up to 15 spikes per loom (9.7 on average on the strongest-gain quartile).
sustained MN rates < 100 Hz; Azevedo 2020; McKellar 2020
